entities.label: Incident
entities.name: orders-api p99 latency spike
entities.summary: orders-api p99 latency above 4s on Oct 15 due to undersized worker pool.

entities.label: Decision
entities.name: ADR-019: Freeze retry policy on orders-api
entities.summary: Freeze retry policy on orders-api to prevent retry storms.

facts.evidence: Vikram Shah resolved the incident at 12:40 UTC by scaling the orders-api worker pool from 8 to 20 workers.
Incident inc:0057, orders-api p99 latency above 4s on Oct 15.
Retries stayed frozen at 2 attempts per ADR-019
